dimensions.assessment: Affects Gateway Arch National Park staff, the Gateway Arch Park Foundation, and visitors using park facilities.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary... may enter into a one-time agreement for a period not to exceed five years with the Foundation to host private events at the Park

dimensions.assessment: Enables private event hosting within national park buildings subject to safety, public access, and resource protection rules.
dimensions.evidence: host private events at the Park, which may include the use of Park buildings

dimensions.assessment: Requires fee collection to cover maintenance, wear and tear, and full cost recovery for administrative, security, and personnel expenses.
dimensions.evidence: recover all costs incurred as a result of the private events and use of the Park and Park buildings, including maintenance, utilities, administrative expenses, security, and personnel costs

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a specific pilot agreement and reporting framework for one national park location.
dimensions.evidence: Gateway Arch National Park Partner Agreement Pilot Project

dimensions.assessment: Pilot agreement capped at five years, with a sunset on authority 7 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: one-time agreement for a period not to exceed five years... sunset on the date that is 7 years after the date of enactment

missing_information: Expected fee amounts or projected revenue totals
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes a 5-year pilot project agreement allowing the Gateway Arch Park Foundation to host private events in specific Gateway Arch National Park buildings under set terms, fees, and cost recovery.
